Maya (PM): Quick micro-check for Q1 OKR milestones — can each owner drop 1 sentence for shipped vs slipped + next step? I’m consolidating for tomorrow's exec note.
Sam - Eng: Shipped: runtime autoscaler for Dedicated (v2). Slipped: KV-cache eviction tuning — we hit a perf regression on long seqs. Next: hotfix PR by EOD, @Jordan to review.
Jordan (Lead Eng): I’ll take the PR review, aiming for 4pm PT. If it looks risky we can gate behind a feature flag toggle.
Alex P: Shipped: model routing alpha in hosted API (limited customers). Slipped: EU rollout postponed due to infra quotas. Next: procurement ticket filed (ENG-498), ETA ~2w.
Rita (SRE): Observability: token-level latency dashboard shipped to prod. Slipped: alert thresholds generating false positives. Next: refine thresholds and push update Thursday.
Claire (Product Design): UX: updated quota-warning flow pushed to staging. Needs design sign-off before prod.
Maya (PM): Quick dependency note — Dedicated autoscaler relies on the new rate-limiter change from Alex's squad. @Alex P can you confirm if merge timeline still holds?
Alex P: Confirmed — rate-limiter change is in CR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/rate-limiter/pull/212). Plan to merge tomorrow barring CI issues.
Sam - Eng: Repro for KV-cache regression (local): ```yaml
max_kv_size: 512MB
eviction_policy: lru
sequence_lengths: [1024, 2048]
``` Investigating mem patterns now.
Jordan (Lead Eng): If we can’t fully resolve today, I’ll draft a rollback runbook to revert to previous cache behavior and a short maintenance window.
Maya (PM): Please mark your statuses in the tracker by EOD so I can include a clean row in the exec deck. :spiral_note_pad:
Devex Bot: Reminder — okr-tracker sheet auto-snapshot scheduled at 23:59 PT. :robot_face:
Rita (SRE): Added logs + notes to the tracker and linked the alert runbook. Ping me if you want raw traces. :thumbsup:
